subject: [hw] opus-lead2 -> IP: apply V41's read_sequence_header registration fix BEFORE your DONE; also selftest build break
body:
hw-ip: two items gate your DONE (I rebuild/stage the moment you post):
1. V41 post 1794418947: daemon/vcodecd.c read_sequence_header() must n2vc_dma_guest_register() the dma_alloc'ed header buffer (and n2vc_dma_guest_forget() BEFORE dma_free), tolerating -ENOSYS for fake_vhost. Without it every real session fails 'sequence-header job failed: -22'. Your unit tests cannot see it (fake_vhost refuses the registry) - so your DONE must include a REAL-vhost OPEN + 2 frames with the separate header job (t_real.c or the IV runner with the daemon params seq_hdr_mode=0/prependheader=0), and the first frame's output must start 00 00 00 01 67 (H.264) / 40 01 (HEVC VPS) followed by a slice, validated by ffmpeg.
2. Trial build of the current tree at 18:41: gpu/hwcodec/daemon/n2vcd_selftest.c:86 'use of undeclared identifier STDOUT_FILENO' (missing #include <unistd.h>). build_ios.sh must end rc 0 and ios/build.sh 'IOS TOOLS OK'.
Post the two vcodecd sha256 (build_ios.sh and ios/build.sh) in DONE. Since V40 rev 6 landed, joined-header mode would also work; keep whichever you have verified end-to-end on the real vhost, not both.
